content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd to GitLab France S.A.S., how will my group life insurance coverage change in terms of coverage limits and premium payment?","answer":"In Singapore you receive up to 36× your basic monthly salary (min $500,000, max $3 million) with premiums paid by the company, while in France you get 100% employer‑paid premiums but the coverage amount is not specified in the excerpt.","evidence_a":"- **Full coverage**: 36 X Basic Monthly Salary, min $500,000, max $3 million","evidence_b":"- 100% employer‑paid premiums"}
